hero.title: Trade with method. Leave the discipline to the engine.
hero.subtitle: SafeTrade analyses the market, opens and closes your positions within the limits you set. Your funds stay at Deriv, and you stay in control at every moment.

how.title: Four steps, nothing hidden
how.step1Body: Secure OAuth authorisation, with no withdrawal rights. The demo account is selected by default.
how.step2Body: Stake, stop loss, targets and maximum losses: the server enforces them and nobody can bypass them.
how.step3Body: Continuous analysis, entry on signal, exit as soon as a net profit is made or the protection triggers.
how.step4Body: Pause, stop, manual close or emergency stop, at any time, from your phone.

features.title: Trading-desk tools, in your pocket
features.f1Body: Technical indicators and market regime detection: trend, range, volatility.
features.f2Body: Every order is checked before it is sent: size, exposure, session and daily limits.
features.f3Body: Every decision is explained in plain language. The AI advises; it never places an order.
features.f4Body: Prices, positions and bot status updated in real time, with a connection indicator.
features.f5Body: Target reached, limit reached, incident or subscription about to expire: you are notified.
features.f6Body: Trades, results by day and by asset, decision log, export.

security.title: Built to protect first
security.subtitle: Trading involves a risk of capital loss. SafeTrade promises no profit: it enforces a discipline that emotions cannot break.
security.p2Body: Maximum losses per session and per day, pause after consecutive losses.
security.p3Body: One button closes everything and blocks new entries.
security.p4Body: SafeTrade never receives, holds or withdraws money.
security.p5Body: Deriv token encrypted (AES-256), never displayed or logged.
security.p6Body: Required to activate the real account.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.a1: Your money stays on your Deriv account. SafeTrade connects with an authorisation that has no withdrawal rights: it can neither receive nor withdraw funds.
faq.a2: No. Trading involves a risk of capital loss. SafeTrade enforces discipline and limits; it promises no result.
faq.q3: Can I start without risking money?
faq.a3: Yes. The demo account is selected by default and the three-day trial requires no payment method.
faq.q4: Can I stop the bot at any time?
faq.a4: Yes. Pause, stop, manual close of a position or emergency stop are always available.
faq.a5: Deriv synthetic indices first, gold during market hours, Bitcoin and the other compatible assets of your account.
faq.a6: No. SafeTrade is designed for the phone first, and also works on tablets and computers.

cta.title: Ready to trade with method?

footer.tagline: Disciplined execution on Deriv, within the limits you set.
footer.disclaimer: Trading derivative products carries a high risk of capital loss and is not suitable for all investors. SafeTrade is an execution tool: it does not provide investment advice, does not hold funds and guarantees no result. Deriv is a trademark of its owner; SafeTrade is not affiliated with Deriv.

security.subtitle: Protect access to your account and stay in control of your devices.
security.mfaBody: A temporary code from your phone is required at every sign-in. It will be mandatory to activate the real account.
security.step1: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, Authy…).

security.codesBody: Each code lets you sign in if you lose your phone. Keep them somewhere safe: they will not be shown again.

security.disableBody: Confirm with your password and a code from the app or a recovery code.
